name: Provision Postgres Readonly Role
summary: Design and verify a least-privilege PostgreSQL role for bounded read access.
description: Prepare reviewed PostgreSQL SQL for a login role that defaults to read-only, has bounded execution, and excludes sensitive relations. Use when humans need to grant an analyst or agent production read access.
risk_reason: It can apply production role grants after explicit authorization, changing live database access.
refuses: It does not grant SUPERUSER, BYPASSRLS, write privileges, or role administration.
It does not embed or print a production password.
It does not apply production DDL without explicit authorization and a revocation plan.

operational.latency_reason: The skill designs and verifies a least-privilege PostgreSQL role for bounded read access, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
